The '''Eternal Empire military''' was the military force of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]].

==History==
While the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Knights of Zakuul]] answered directly to the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] and the [[High Justice]], Zakuulan military was composed of regular conscripts and [[skytrooper]]s, though they always worked in conjunction with the Knights and were deployed simultaneously.<ref name="KOTFE 3">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=3}}</ref> The majority of the Eternal Empire fighting force was composed of [[Droid/Legends|droids]], either the [[GEMINI]] units that commanded the [[Eternal Fleet]],<ref name="KOTFE 14">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=14}}</ref> or the various skytrooper models that filled the ranks of ground soldiers. [[Human/Legends|Humans]] held only a few key positions such as [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] [[Eternal Empire shuttle]]s and [[Eternal Empire Walker]]s, as well as serving as crew members on the few ships that were not part of the Eternal Fleet.<ref name="KOTFE 4" />

After the [[assassination of Valkorion]] and ascension of his son [[Arcann]] to the [[Eternal Throne]] in [[3636 BBY]], Zakuul revealed itself to the larger galaxy and led a swift and brutal [[Eternal Empire conquest]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], which the natives of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] world of Zakuul called the larger part of the known galaxy. During the [[Occupation of Denon]] ground forces were ordered to fire on protesting civilians, but [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Koth Vortena]] and his men, including [[Len Parvek]], refused to follow that order and defected. This contributed to further phasing out of non-skytrooper Human personnel, and by the time the galaxy rose up in the [[war against Zakuul]] five years later, only skytroopers and the Knights of Zakuul were commonly deployed on other worlds, with non Force-sensitive Human personnel mostly restricted to the security force on Zakuul itself.<ref name="KOTFE 4" /> Despite this, [[Eternal Empire trooper]]s were tasked with guarding the shield generator bunkers for [[Star Fortress]]es, and [[Zakuul soldiers]] were deployed by Empress [[Vaylin]] during the [[Assault on Odessen]].<ref name="KOTFE 4" />

The revolt eventually succeeded, with the [[Eternal Alliance]] achieving victory over Zakuul and dismantling the Eternal Empire. The people of Zakuul were left free to rule themselves, and the Alliance seized control over Zakuul's military assets, including the Eternal Fleet.<ref name="KOTET 9" /> Some former soldiers and Knights of Zakuul joined the Alliance military, which also incorporated Zakuulan skytroopers and walkers, while others went rogue, joining either Battalion Commander [[Tassar (Human)|Tassar]]<ref name="Rakata">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=uprising|Uprising: Landing Party}}</ref> or [[Vinn Atrius]]'s [[Order of Zildrog]].<ref name="Nathema">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|The Nathema Conspiracy}}</ref>
